claims.evidence: The witness report lists whether the machine powers on and functions as not shown; photos show only the exterior and controls.

risks.risk: Machine does not power on or function
risks.proof: Video clip of the machine powering up and running or stitching under load
risks.if_unproven: Priced as non-working, for parts or repair only

risks.risk: Age or year of manufacture unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the nameplate, serial number, or manufacturing date sticker
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown age, worst-case older machine

risks.risk: No service history or maintenance records
risks.proof: Service log, maintenance receipts, or technician report
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unserviced with unknown maintenance

risks.proof: Photo showing all included parts, accessories, and tooling
risks.if_unproven: Priced as machine only, without accessories

risks.risk: Voltage or power requirements unknown for Lagos supply
risks.proof: Photo of the voltage/power rating plate
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incompatible or requiring an external transformer

risks.risk: Internal damage or wear not visible in photos
risks.proof: Video of operation with covers open, or internal inspection photos
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having hidden internal wear or damage

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and running or stitching
Photo of the nameplate showing brand, model, serial number, and manufacturing date
Photo of the voltage/power rating plate
Photo showing all included parts and accessories
response.reason: The witness identified the item as an industrial printing machine, so it can be priced at its worst case even without brand or model. The seller's working-condition claim is unverified by the photos and would need a running video to raise the value.
